natural_body: Price-sensitive SMB 40% off: signups +31%, revenue +18%, retention -12%; renewals weak.

first.rationale: Activation and onboarding completion are both declining 4-6% QoQ, indicating a product engagement problem rather than a pricing or acquisition problem. Memory_91 shows activation messaging lifted week-one engagement and first meaningful action; memory_86 shows shortening onboarding improved completion; memory_31 shows signup simplification improved SMB activation. The current situation mirrors the conditions that made activation messaging and streamlined onboarding work before. A standard experiment on in-product activation messaging targets the immediate engagement drop without exposing the company to the risks that promotional pricing created (memory_73 showed -12% retention and weak renewals). This preserves ability to defend against competitive pricing through product stickiness rather than margin erosion. Verifying memory_31 and memory_91 will confirm the magnitude of prior lifts and whether conditions have changed.
